output.headline: Evolent Health, Epic Systems and Blackstone lead the health IT buyer universe; the comparable median is defensible and top names can pay it.
sentences: Call Evolent Health first, since it has 3 deals in the target's own sub-sector and closed $325M, then Blackstone and Epic Systems, the other High-conviction names. [E:tier1, E:conviction]
Defend the median of 21.4x EV/EBITDA within a 19.4x to 23.3x range; sponsors like Blackstone can reach $356M and beat their 20% target at 25.3% IRR at the ask. [E:valuation, E:lbo]
The review removed Ciox Health (now Datavant) and Cerner (now Oracle), and merged Change Healthcare into UnitedHealth Group, so none of the three is approached separately. [E:review]
Most buyers share one motive: diversification and technology capability, present in 100% of 50 Health IT deals, followed by growth at 90%. [E:motives]
